name: nekko-agent-workspace
description: Nekko Agent: your local agent, backed by frontier intelligence, with CLI/MCP integration and workflows.
author: ermish

scripts.build: npm run build:nekkod && npm run build:app
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @nekko-agent/shared && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/core
scripts.build:web: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/host && npm run build --workspace=apps/cli && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/desktop && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/server && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/cloud
scripts.cloud: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/host && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/desktop && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/cloud && npm run start -w @nekko-agent/cloud
scripts.dev: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build:dev && npm run dev -w @nekko-agent/desktop
scripts.local: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/host && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/desktop && node apps/desktop/scripts/stage-daemon.mjs --optional && npm run start -w @nekko-agent/desktop
scripts.web: npm run build:web && npm run start -w @nekko-agent/server
scripts.bundle:web: npm run build:web && npm run bundle -w @nekko-agent/server
scripts.test: node --test scripts/serve-website.test.mjs scripts/clean-builds.test.mjs scripts/ci-cache.test.mjs scripts/ci-scope.test.mjs scripts/perf/provenance.test.mjs scripts/pr-media.test.mjs scripts/electron-downloader.test.mjs scripts/update-runtime-releases.test.mjs scripts/build-commands.test.mjs scripts/build-docs.test.mjs scripts/vc-runtime.test.mjs && npm run test -w @nekko-agent/shared && npm run test -w @nekko-agent/core && npm run test -w @nekko-agent/desktop && npm run test -w @nekko-agent/cloud && npm run test -w @nekko-agent/host && npm run test -w @nekko-agent/server && npm run test -w @nekko-agent/relay && npm run test --workspace=apps/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @nekko-agent/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nekko-agent/core && npm run typecheck -w @nekko-agent/host && npm run build --workspace=apps/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/cli && npm run typecheck -w @nekko-agent/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @nekko-agent/server && npm run typecheck -w @nekko-agent/relay && npm run typecheck -w @nekko-agent/cloud
scripts.relay: npm run build -w @nekko-agent/relay && npm run start -w @nekko-agent/relay
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @nekko-agent/desktop
scripts.build:dev: node apps/desktop/scripts/stage-daemon.mjs --dev && npm run build:core && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/host && npm run build --workspace=apps/cli && npm run build:app --workspace=apps/cli
scripts.build:app: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/host && npm run build --workspace=apps/cli && npm run build:app --workspace=apps/cli && npm run build -w @nekko-agent/desktop
